author: fwyzard
body: #### PR description: The streamer output modules accept `compression_algorithm` "LZ4", with `compression_level` 1-3 for the fast LZ4 compressor and 4-12 for LZ4 HC (ROOT uses the same split and stops at 9). Since the fast compressor does not take a compression level, the streamer files created for levels 1-3 are identical. Compressed events start with the `L4` header, and the input sources and `DiagStreamerFile` detect and decompress them like the other algorithms. The output tests now take a compression level; NewStreamer run the round trip at levels 1 (fast), 2 ("mid") and 4 (HC). LZ4 is faster than zstd level 1, but creates significantly larger files. LZ4HC is as slow as zlib and zstd, so it's only useful when the fastest decompression is needed. #### PR validation: Unit tests pass. Streamer files in LZ4 format were read back and used to measure the Phase 2 HLT performance.
title: Add LZ4 compression to the streamer format
